posts.title: SSH Config Shortcut
posts.body:
Di `~/.ssh/config`:
```
Host stb1
    HostName 192.168.1.12
    User aisixzuperlabs
    Port 22
```
Sekarang tinggal: `ssh stb1`

posts.title: Docker Layer Optimization
posts.body:
Susun Dockerfile dengan yang paling sering berubah di paling bawah:
```dockerfile
# Least change — base image, deps, config
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

# More change — app code
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

posts.title: Redis vs Cache Database
posts.body:
Redis bukan pengganti database — gunakan untuk:
1. Session storage (with TTL)
2. Cache layer (read-through pattern)
3. Rate limiting
4. Job queue (Redis Queue)
5. Leaderboard (sorted sets)

Strategi: cache-aside pattern
```python
# Read
data = redis.get(key)
if not data:
    data = db.query(...)
    redis.setex(key, 3600, data)
```
